mapper.select: SELECT lDongRegnCd AS "lDongRegnCd", regn_name AS "regnName" FROM ldong_regn_code ORDER BY lDongRegnCd
SELECT lDongRegnCd AS "lDongRegnCd", lDongSignguCd AS "lDongSignguCd", signgu_name AS "signguName" FROM ldong_signgu_code WHERE lDongRegnCd = #{lDongRegnCd} ORDER BY lDongSignguCd
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO destination target USING ( SELECT #{contentid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS contentid, #{contenttypeid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS contenttypeid, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS title, #{tel, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS tel, #{addr1, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS addr1, #{addr2, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS addr2, #{zipcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS zipcode, #{lDongRegnCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS lDongRegnCd, #{lDongSignguCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS lDongSignguCd, #{mapx, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS mapx, #{mapy, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS mapy, #{mlevel, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS mlevel, #{firstimage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS firstimage, #{firstimage2, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS firstimage2, #{modifiedtime, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS modifiedtime FROM DUAL ) source ON (target.contentid = source.contentid) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.contenttypeid = source.contenttypeid, target.title = source.title, target.tel = source.tel, target.addr1 = source.addr1, target.addr2 = source.addr2, target.zipcode = source.zipcode, target.lDongRegnCd = source.lDongRegnCd, target.lDongSignguCd = source.lDongSignguCd, target.mapx = source.mapx, target.mapy = source.mapy, target.mlevel = source.mlevel, target.firstimage = source.firstimage, target.firstimage2 = source.firstimage2, target.modifiedtime = source.modifiedtime, target.sync_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( contentid, contenttypeid, title, tel, addr1, addr2, zipcode, lDongRegnCd, lDongSignguCd, mapx, mapy, mlevel, firstimage, firstimage2, modifiedtime, view_count, sync_date, created_at ) VALUES ( source.contentid, source.contenttypeid, source.title, source.tel, source.addr1, source.addr2, source.zipcode, source.lDongRegnCd, source.lDongSignguCd, source.mapx, source.mapy, source.mlevel, source.firstimage, source.firstimage2, source.modifiedtime, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE destination SET overview = #{overview, jdbcType=CLOB}, homepage = #{homepage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sync_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE contentid = #{contentid}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM destination WHERE overview IS NULL

SELECT /*+ FIRST_ROWS(4) */ * FROM ( SELECT d.CONTENTID AS contentid, d.TITLE AS title, d.ADDR1 AS addr1, d.MAPX AS mapx, d.MAPY AS mapy, d.CONTENTTYPEID AS contenttypeid, d.FIRSTIMAGE AS firstimage, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(d.OVERVIEW, 200, 1) AS overview FROM DESTINATION d WHERE d.FIRSTIMAGE IS NOT NULL AND d.FIRSTIMAGE != ' ' AND d.OVERVIEW IS NOT NULL ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{size}
